ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB \parallel CF$, and E is the midpoint of $DF$. If $AB = 8\,cm$ and $CF = 5\,cm$, then how many centimeters is $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB\parallel CF$,\\
thus $\angle A=\angle ACF$, $\angle F=\angle ADE$,\\
since E is the midpoint of $DF$,\\
thus $DE=EF$,\\
in $\triangle ADE$ and $\triangle CFE$, $\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle A=\angle ECF\\
\angle ADE=\angle F\\
DE=EF
\end{array}\right.$,\\
therefore $\triangle ADE\cong \triangle CFE$ (by AAS),\\
thus $CF=AD=5cm$,\\
thus $BD=AB-AD=8-5=\boxed{3cm}$,

Thus $BD = AB - AD = 8 - 5 = \boxed{3\,cm}$.
